facts: This appeal has been filed against the impugned judgment of the Allahabad High Court dated 4.8.2006 in Criminal Appeal No.1099 of 1981.

The prosecution version, as disclosed by P.W.2 Ali Raja in the F.I.R. lodged at 9.25 a.m. on 19.12.1979 at P.S. Raunapur Azamgarh was that there was a dispute between him and the accused (appellants) regarding the flow of the drainage of his latrine which was disrupted by the accused appellants by making constructions and by raising the level of their land;
The case was committed to the Court of Sessions, the charges were framed against the accused appellants and thereafter eight prosecution witnesses and one Court witness were examined.

P.W.2 Ali Raza (complainant) deposed on 24.11.1980 that about 11 months ago at about half past 7 a.m. he and his brothers Mustakin and Abdul Qayum were clearning their Nabdan situated near the boundary wall of Samkadar;

Qamaru Zama, Maqbool, Imtiaz, Munsafi, Gayasuddin, Mohd. Yusuf, Hasnain, Sharif, Ramjan, Ayoob and Anwar after forming an assembly, reached there; that the accused Qamaru Zama, Maqbool and Imtiaz were armed with spears whereas the other nine accused persons were armed with lathies;
The occurrence took place one hour after sun-rise about 11 months back; that he and his brother Ali Raza were cleaning their Nabdan and his another brother Abdul Qayum was digging a pit;
P.W.4 Salauddin deposed that the occurrence took place one hour after sun-rise; that he was at his tube-well which was hardly 100 yards away from the place of occurrence;
Qamaru Zama inflicted spear blow on Abdul Qayum who sustaining the spear injury fell down; that Ali Raza succeeded in fleeing away but Mustakin could not make good his escape;
P.W.5 deposed on 26.11.1980 that the occurrence took place about 11 months back about one hour after sun-rise; that he was going towards his field from his house;
The complainant and his brothers did not stop working even after the objection raised by the accused persons; that accused Qamaru Zama attacked Abdul Qayum by inflcting a spear blow upon him;
Qamaru Zama, armed with a spear (deadly weapon) along with the appellants who were also armed with spears (and 9 others armed with lathis), reached their and forbade them from cleaning the Nabdan.

The complainant and his brothers did not stop the cleaning work of Nabdan. Then appellant Qamaru Zama inflicted the spear blow upon Abdul Qayum and the appellants Imtiaz and Maqbool inflicted spear blows on Mustakin.
issues: What was the nature of the dispute between the accused (appellants) and the complainant?
Were the accused (appellants) armed with deadly weapons, such as spears, at the time of the occurrence?
Was the act of the accused (appellants) premeditated or sudden?

Did the accused (appellants) discharge the burden of proving that the complainant or his brothers abused or used any other provocative words which were sufficient to provoke a reasonable person in ordinary circumstances?
petitioner_arguments: The appellants failed to discharge this burden.
The incident, therefore, was not sudden and does not fall within Exception 4 of S. 300 IPC.

For taking the benefit of the sudden provocation under exception 1 of S. 300 IPC, it was incumbent upon the appellants to prove beyond doubt that the complainant or his brothers abused or used any other provocative words which were sufficient to provoke a reasonable person in ordinary circumstances.
court_reasoning: The holding of deadly weapons such as spears and their conduct both show that the appellants reached there with a definite intention.
For claiming any exception, the burden heavily lies upon the accused.
The act of the accused was premeditated, and not sudden.
The incident, therefore, was not sudden and does not fall within Exception 4 of S. 300 IPC.
holding: The appellants failed to discharge this burden.
The incident, therefore, was not sudden and does not fall within Exception 4 of S. 300 IPC.
